data.notes: February 2027 is anchored by major electronic/festival travel moments around Bahidorá and EDC México, with CDMX Art Week club programming already starting to surface.

events.title: EDC México 2027
events.summary: EDC México is confirmed for February 19–21, 2027 in Mexico City, with the official site selling 3-day ticket tiers. The festival is the month's global electronic flagship, centered on large-scale dance stages, production and performers.

events.title: Bahidorá 2027
events.summary: Bahidorá confirms its 15th-anniversary edition for February 12–14, 2027 at Las Estacas, Morelos, with three-day and two-day passes announced. The lineup is not yet posted on the source page, but the festival is confirmed as a music, art and nature weekend.

events.title: Giegling in Mexico City 2027
events.summary: Dynamic Waves brings the cult German label Giegling back to Mexico City during Art Week for a 12-hour house and minimal-techno session at Frontón Bucareli; lineup is still TBA, but the brand and venue make it a destination-level underground date.

events.title: Fuerza Regida at Palacio de los Deportes
events.summary: Ticketmaster lists Fuerza Regida at Palacio de los Deportes on February 6, 2027, part of a multi-date CDMX run also listed on the artist page. This is a major música mexicana arena-level booking for the month.

events.title: The Warning - Everything's Falling World Tour
events.summary: Ticketmaster confirms The Warning's Everything's Falling World Tour at Estadio GNP Seguros on February 5, 2027. The listing names The Linda Lindas on the lineup as support.

events.title: Hilary Duff: the lucky me tour
events.summary: Ticketmaster lists Hilary Duff's the lucky me tour at Palacio de los Deportes on February 12, 2027, with another CDMX date shown for February 13. This is a major pop booking for the month.

events.title: Urbano Fest CDMX Vol. 2
events.summary: C-Kan’s Mexican rap and urbano showcase returns to Pepsi Center WTC across two nights, with Ticketmaster listing C-Kan on both 20 and 21 February dates; a strong domestic hip-hop/Latin scene event rather than an arena-pop headliner.

events.title: Jorge Drexler at Auditorio Nacional
events.summary: Ticketmaster lists Jorge Drexler at Auditorio Nacional on February 20, 2027. The Grammy- and Latin Grammy-winning Uruguayan songwriter is a strong Latin singer-songwriter draw during EDC weekend.

events.title: La Roux: The Old Flames Tour
events.venueName: Pabellón del Palacio de los Deportes
events.summary: Ticketmaster lists La Roux's The Old Flames Tour at Pabellón del Palacio de los Deportes on February 25, 2027. The date adds a synth-pop/electronic touring show to the post-EDC week.

events.title: Sin Bandera at Auditorio Nacional
events.summary: Ticketmaster confirms Sin Bandera at Auditorio Nacional on February 7, 2027. The duo's CDMX date adds a mainstream Latin-pop draw to the first February concert weekend.

events.title: Urbano Fest
events.summary: Ticketmaster's Pepsi Center WTC calendar lists Urbano Fest on February 21, 2027, with Festival Urbano and C-Kan on the lineup. The show represents the month's confirmed urban/hip-hop programming at a major indoor venue.

events.title: Leyendas de la Cumbia
events.summary: Ticketmaster confirms Leyendas de la Cumbia at Auditorio Nacional on February 21, 2027. The listed lineup includes La Sonora Dinamita and Los Socios del Ritmo.

events.title: Carlos Sadness at Auditorio Nacional
events.summary: Ticketmaster lists Spanish indie-pop artist Carlos Sadness at Auditorio Nacional on February 5, 2027. It is one of the early confirmed Auditorio Nacional popular-music dates for February.

events.title: María Daniela y su Sonido Lasser
events.summary: The Pepsi Center WTC Ticketmaster calendar lists María Daniela y su Sonido Lasser on February 12, 2027. The booking brings a local electro-pop staple into a large CDMX room during the same weekend as several major pop dates.

events.title: Hilary Duff — The Lucky Me Tour
events.summary: A second Hilary Duff date for The Lucky Me Tour is confirmed at Palacio de los Deportes on February 13, 2027.

events.title: Westlife — 25: The Anniversary World Tour
events.summary: Westlife’s anniversary tour is listed for Arena CDMX on February 27, 2027, with Songkick showing the event and Super Boletos ticketing availability.

events.title: Santiago Cruz — Sigo en Pie Tour
events.summary: Colombian singer-songwriter Santiago Cruz brings his Sigo en Pie Tour to Teatro Metropólitan, with Ticketmaster listing the date and venue for February 4, 2027.

events.title: Andrés Suárez — Gira Lua
events.summary: Spanish singer-songwriter Andrés Suárez is confirmed for Teatro Metropólitan on the Gira Lua tour, as listed by Ticketmaster for February 5, 2027.
